decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds directly on the firm's core psychiatric treatment expertise, so its multidisciplinary teams can interpret utilization and keep refining it, and it holds a dedicated page.
Senior living counseling draws on deep eldercare knowledge, costs little to run, and feeds clients into the firm's residential and outpatient services.

The retail shop uses the sheltered workshop's existing production, but retail know-how lies further from the firm's care knowledge, and the related carpentry offer was already dropped, so risk is moderate though keeping it is still justified.

Meal delivery fits the firm's eldercare and everyday-assistance expertise and its kitchen capabilities, but it is new, only mentioned on the website, and its early results are not yet clear, so it carries moderate uncertainty.
